dct_description_sm: Data is collected with the purpose of mapping the costs of adapting housing infrastructure to environmental changes, in particular changes in permafrost (working title: 'Cost-of-Adaptation Mapping', or COAM). Building on standard hazard maps that identify the suitability of land for infrastructure development, COAM looks at areas that are subject to landscape hazards to work out adaptation options to build on these areas, and what the costs of these adaptation options are if they are implemented. Collected data is shared with geotechnical engineers and economists to provide feasible adaptation options for the Hamlet of Arviat.
